authority_note: Worker evidence only. Cannot set node status=done, validation_status=passed, or any gate verdict. Read-only on every canonical/review path; writes confined to artifacts/worker-054/cf31_symmetric_accept_table/.
controls: K1 accept+explicit full+live frozen+non-author -> counted v0..v3
K2 accept+flag absent -> counted v0, excluded v1..v3
K3 accept+explicit full+stale frozen -> counted v0,v1, excluded v2,v3
K4 accept+flag=false (scoped) -> excluded v1..v3, counted v0 only if default rule treats false as full (it must not)
K5 pin mentioned only in findings text -> not bound, excluded everywhere
K6 author self-accept -> excluded everywhere (non-author factor)
K7 superseded accept (later revise by same reviewer) -> excluded everywhere
K9 stale pin (other leg hash) -> excluded everywhere
K10 path-target accept with no explicit pin field, live frozen -> excluded v0..v2, counted v3
decision_rule: For each leg report the distinct-reviewer witness set and count under v0/v1/v2/v3; the robust count is the minimum over v1/v2/v3. G-FORM's >=2 criterion is ROBUSTLY MET for a leg iff the robust count >=2; FRAGILE iff some published variant gives <2 while another gives >=2; NOT MET iff all variants give <2.
falsifier: Any counted file whose declared pin does not equal the leg pin; any control not behaving as declared; any live input hash differing from the pin table at run start or end; any change of witness set on a byte-identical re-run. The robustness statement is void once rev14 moves any of the three schema bytes.
non_claims: not a claim about mathematics or physics
rationale: CF-31/REC-39 adjudicates the F2b accept-count divergence only. G-FORM's acceptance criterion is per class, so r3 needs the same binding evidence for F1 and F2a. This task generalizes the count question symmetrically: for all three legs at the measured pins, compute the distinct-reviewer accept witness set under every published strictness factor and its intersection (minimum).

rules.BIND_path: BIND_strict OR the declared target path (artifact/target_id/reviewed_artifact/target) names L's canonical path and no declared pin field conflicts with H.
rules.BIND_strict: A review file targets leg L at pin H iff (a) a declared target-pin field in {artifact_sha256,reviewed_sha256,target_sha256,schema_sha256,pinned_sha256} equals H, or (b) target_id/reviewed_artifact/target contains H as a 64-hex token. Mentions of H only in findings/notes/evidence text do NOT bind.
VARIANTS: v0_default = BIND_strict + accept + full_default + non-author + controlling
v3_path_bind_live_strict = BIND_path + accept + full_strict + live_frozen + non-author + controlling
rules.V_author: reviewer is not in the derived author set for the leg (author set = actors of accepted artifact events whose path is the leg canonical or mirror path)
rules.V_full_default: counts_as_full_schema_verdict is True, or the field is absent (controller default documented in W48-CR-F3)
rules.V_live_frozen: a FROZEN generation token equal to the live FROZEN hash 815e08079aef (full or >=8 hex prefix) appears in a declared/referenced FROZEN field or in target/scope text; stale_other if a different FROZEN hash/revision is declared; unspecified otherwise
rules.V_supersession: per (leg, reviewer), the controlling record is the latest by created_at (fallback file mtime); an accept counts only if it is the controlling record. A record that declares supersedes=<path or hash> removes the referenced record.
